entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David, I need to start a return for a helmet I purchased a while back.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Alex Smith, and the order number is VF-8675309.

Thank you, Alex. I'm pulling up your order now... Yes, I see the AeroPro helmet. To make sure I handle this correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's just a preference. The product photos made the color look like a matte gray, but it's much shinier in person. The box is still unopened, so it's brand new.
I understand completely. Let me just review the return eligibility for your order. One moment.

Okay, Alex, I've checked the policy. It looks like you received the helmet 47 days ago, and our standard return window is 90 days. So, you are well within the timeframe. I can approve this return for you right now.

That's great, I appreciate that. Since I do plan on ordering a different helmet to replace it, would it be possible to get a 10% discount code for the new purchase, just for the inconvenience of having to send this one back?

I'm glad I could get the return sorted for you. While I'm not able to provide a discount code, I have just emailed you a pre-paid return label. As soon as we receive the item, you'll get a full refund to your original payment method.
Alright, a full refund works. I had to ask. I still trust your gear for its safety ratings, so I'll be placing that new order shortly. Thanks for your help.
Of course. Happy to help. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you.
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
